metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API: CMMC Level 2 selected practices (NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3)
metadata.remarks: The five CMMC L2 practices enforced by this repository's Rego policies, as Rev. 3 controls: AC.L2-3.1.1 -> 03.01.01, MP.L2-3.8.9 -> 03.08.09, SC.L2-3.13.1 -> 03.13.01, SC.L2-3.13.8 -> 03.13.08, SC.L2-3.13.11 -> 03.13.11.
